name: Sample Matching for Extinction Gradients
aliases: Sample Matching for Joint Extinction Gradient Estimation
definition: A technique for differentiating volumetric transport with respect to the extinction coefficient by evaluating the scattering term (positive contribution) and the transmittance term (negative contribution) at shared locations along each path segment, turning their negative correlation into variance reduction.
summary: Sample Matching for Extinction Gradients reduces variance by evaluating opposing scattering and transmittance terms at shared spatial locations, unlike base methods that use unrelated points.
